name: GDELT Project API
rate_limits: Rate-limited but no published numerical caps; 250 articles per query; default searches last 24 hours; 3-month rolling window
notes: The largest open database of human society — monitors print, broadcast, and web news in 100+ languages from every country. Updates every 15 minutes. Historical data back to 1979. NO authentication required — completely open. Multiple sub-APIs: DOC 2.0 (full-text search), GEO 2.0 (geographic), TV 2.0 (television news), Context 2.0. Extremely useful for AI: provides entity extraction, sentiment, themes, tone analysis, and event coding out of the box. DOC API endpoint: /api/v2/doc/doc?query=TERM. Python client: gdeltdoc on PyPI. Medium reliability due to undocumented rate limits and occasional query inconsistencies.
